title: Update Landing Page features intro copy to mention admin approvals

requirements.text: Update ONLY the Landing Page Features Section intro block (the div at XPath /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/div[1]/section[2]/div[1]/div[1]) and its paragraph (XPath /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/div[1]/section[2]/div[1]/div[1]/p[1]) to reflect that RideBook supports an admin panel/flow to review and approve (admit) registered users before they can use the app, keeping all user-facing text in English.
acceptanceCriteria: Only the content within the selected Features Section intro container (and its paragraph) is changed; no other page sections/components are modified.
The updated copy clearly communicates that admins can review/approve registered users ("admit" users) before they can use the service.
All updated user-facing text is in English.
The app builds and the Landing Page renders without runtime errors.

constraints: Apply changes ONLY to the two user-selected elements identified by the provided XPaths (the Features Section intro container and its paragraph).
Do not modify any other UI elements, routes, backend logic, or data models as part of this change.
nonGoals: Implementing an actual admin panel UI, routes, or backend APIs for approving users.
Adding new authentication/authorization behavior or role management.
Changing any other Landing Page sections (Hero, Services, CTA) or other pages.
